segments.name: IP Licensing
segments.description: Ceva licenses wireless connectivity, sensing and AI inference IP, processors and software to semiconductor and OEM customers who integrate them into their chips.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its business on a basis of one reportable segment: the licensing of IP to semiconductor companies and electronic equipment manufacturers

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor and OEM customers pay license fees, and later royalties, plus support and professional services fees, for the right to use Ceva's IP in their chips.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates its revenues from (1) licensing intellectual properties, which in certain circumstances are modified for customer-specific requirements, (2) royalty revenues, and (3) other revenues, which include revenues from support, professional services, training and sale of development systems and chips

changes.text: In 2023 the Company sold its Intrinsix subsidiary, whose results are reported as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: As a result of the Transaction, Intrinsix's results of operations are disclosed as a discontinued operation, including the resulting income from the sale.
